body:
`cps/progress_syncing/protocols/kosync.py`, `record_percentage_only_progress`.

The read/compare/write implementing "furthest wins" is not atomic. Concurrent
browser and device commits can interleave so the later, lower write lands last:
stored 40%; browser A reads 40 and accepts 50; device B reads 40 and writes 60
plus a real xpointer; A commits 50 plus the sentinel. The row regresses to 50%
and the valid locator is gone.

Narrow window, self-heals on the next device push, so not a ship-stopper alone.
Wants a conditional `UPDATE ... WHERE percentage <= :incoming` with upsert
handling for the absent-row case, plus a two-writer concurrency test asserting
the furthest survives. Raised by the cross-family review on PR #1427 and
dispositioned there as tracked.
title: Lost update on the shared kosync row
